h1: Greenfield Residence Prachinburi — a quiet residence down a soi with clean rooms, near Abhaibhubejhr
intro: If you're in Prachinburi for errands, visiting someone at Abhaibhubejhr hospital, or exploring the town with your own car, and you want somewhere quiet and clean on a few-hundred-baht budget — Greenfield Residence is a name budget-minded Prachinburi travellers mention. It's a 3-star residence-style property down a soi in Tha Ngam, Mueang District, with 32 rooms. The draw is the quiet, rooms that real reviews praise for cleanliness, private balconies with garden views, and a location just a 5-minute drive from Abhaibhubejhr hospital and Wat Kaeo Phichit. Rates start at about ฿650/night, rising to around ฿800 for deluxe rooms or long weekends.

body.html: The heart of Greenfield Residence is its quiet setting and its closeness to Chao Phraya Abhaibhubejhr hospital. It sits down a soi in Tha Ngam, Mueang District, about 200 m in from the main road. It's roughly a 5-minute drive to Abhaibhubejhr hospital and Wat Kaeo Phichit, a Prachinburi landmark, and it's not far from the Prachin Buri River. For anyone here to visit a patient, run errands in town, or sightsee with a car, it's both handy and a more restful night than a hotel on a busy main road.

The property itself is a simple residence building set in a garden. There are 32 rooms split between standard and deluxe (around 20 sq m). Inside you get air-con, a fridge, a flat-screen TV with cable channels, and a private balcony with garden views. What real reviews agree on is that rooms are clean and free of musty smells, a good size, with comfy beds and the essentials like a hairdryer and a fridge - good value for a few hundred up to around ฿800.
"Clean rooms, comfy beds, nice and quiet, good for relaxing, cheap and easy to reach, close to the hospital and restaurants - it's only a short way into the soi."

The facilities are fair for this level of property. There's free parking, a 24-hour front desk and CCTV in the common areas. There's a garden and sitting terrace, a snack bar with room service, laundry/dry-cleaning, and free luggage storage. Breakfast is served roughly 8-9 am - it's local cuisine for an extra fee, not a big buffet, but enough to start the day. Wi-Fi is free in the common areas.

The Tha Ngam location is also handy for onward trips. Beyond Abhaibhubejhr and Wat Kaeo Phichit, both a 5-minute drive away, you can carry on about 18 km to Khao Ito Waterfall, or about 23 km to the Prachinburi side of Khao Yai National Park. Anyone using this as a quiet base for a night before moving on to Khao Yai or Kabin Buri the next day can plan it neatly, since it's on the town side with easy access to the main roads.

To be honest about a couple of things worth knowing before you book: the property is down a soi, set back a little from the main road, so it suits guests with their own car. Without a car, getting in and out is harder than from a town-centre hotel. Parking is limited and may fill up when it's busy. Some reviews also mention water seepage in the bathroom during heavy rain. And because it's a residence rather than a resort, there's no pool or spa - if you want full facilities, this isn't that kind of place.

Overall, Greenfield Residence earns solid real-review scores on Trip.com and TripAdvisor, especially for cleanliness, quiet and its modest prices. Rates start around ฿650 for a standard room, rising to about ฿800 for a deluxe or a long weekend. If you want a quiet, clean room with a private balcony, free parking and a short hop to Abhaibhubejhr on a modest budget, this place hits the mark.

A tip from following the reviews here: pin the location on your map before you set off, as it's down a soi and can be a little tricky to find the first time. Ask for an upper-floor or garden-facing room for a quieter feel and a better view from the balcony. And if you're here to visit a patient at Abhaibhubejhr, choosing this place saves a lot of back-and-forth to the hospital.

faq.q: Where is Greenfield Residence in Prachinburi, and what's nearby?
faq.a: Greenfield Residence is at 98 Tha Ngam, Mueang District, Prachinburi. It's down a soi, about 200 m in from the main road. It's about a 5-minute drive to Chao Phraya Abhaibhubejhr hospital and Wat Kaeo Phichit, near the Prachin Buri River. It's roughly 18 km to Khao Ito Waterfall and 23 km to the Prachinburi side of Khao Yai.

faq.q: How much does Greenfield Residence cost, and what room types are there?
faq.a: Rates start at around ฿650/night for a Standard queen room. Choices run from Standard and Deluxe queen to a Deluxe twin. Prices rise to about ฿800 for a deluxe room or a long weekend. There are special long-stay rates for monthly bookings - ask the front desk directly.

faq.q: What are the rooms like at Greenfield Residence?
faq.a: Rooms are simple, with air-con, a fridge, a flat-screen TV with cable channels, a hairdryer, and a private balcony with garden views. Deluxe rooms are around 20 sq m. Real reviews praise clean, good-sized rooms with no musty smell and comfy beds.

faq.q: Does Greenfield Residence have parking and breakfast?
faq.a: Yes to both. There's free parking (limited spaces), a 24-hour front desk, and CCTV in the common areas. Breakfast is served roughly 8-9 am - local cuisine for an extra fee. There's also a snack bar with room service and a laundry service.

faq.q: Who is Greenfield Residence best for?
faq.a: It's a great fit for anyone with a car who is visiting a patient at Abhaibhubejhr, running errands in town, or wanting a quiet, clean room on a modest budget. It also works as a quiet base for a night before moving on to Khao Yai or Kabin Buri. But if you don't have a car or want a hillside resort, this is down a soi with no pool or spa.

faq.q: Is Greenfield Residence easy to reach without a car?
faq.a: It's harder than a town-centre hotel. The property is down a soi, about 200 m in from the main road, so it suits guests with their own car. Without a car and wanting to walk to the market and park, look at IRabbit Hotel or Jiphome in the town centre instead.
